title: Regional MODIS chlorophyll seasonality
query: Using monthly MODIS-Aqua chlorophyll for 2003–2012, compare seasonal variability in two benchmark-defined South China Sea boxes: coastal 112–115 E, 21–23 N and offshore 115–118 E, 17–20 N. Compute area-weighted monthly time series and calendar-month climatologies, report valid-pixel coverage, and quantify seasonal timing and amplitude. These are coordinate boxes, not the paper's 500 m bathymetric shelf/basin partition. Use only the supplied public data and coordinate-defined masks; no private profiles, author simulations or additional measurements are required. Report methods, executed numerical evidence, a concise interpretation and an editable analysis.ipynb. The reference paper motivates the diagnostic, but its observational values are not target answers for this adapted input.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
